snapshot.baseline: Proposed v2 metric dictionary; targets are not current claims

records.name: Plan-generation success
records.formula: COUNT(terminal plan-generation jobs with state=ready) / COUNT(non-cancelled terminal plan-generation jobs)
records.timezone: UTC event time; no local-date grouping unless explicitly requested
exclusions: synthetic traffic unless labeled as a separate series

records.name: Ready-plan completeness
records.formula: COUNT(READY plans satisfying four-action/sixteen-reachable-image invariant) / COUNT(all READY plans)
records.timezone: Plan immutable timezone/local_date; evaluated at publication and rechecked in UTC

records.name: Action completion
records.formula: COUNT(distinct eligible active items whose latest canonical event is completed) / COUNT(eligible active items)
records.grain: Eligible action-plan item over the selected reporting period
records.timezone: Use stored plan timezone and local_date for daily grouping
records.notes: Implemented in the v2 progress query; PostgreSQL and staging verification remains required.

records.name: Daily adherence
records.formula: COUNT(completed active items) / COUNT(items presented for the closed user-local day)
records.grain: User and closed local business date
records.timezone: Immutable IANA timezone and local_date stored on plan/streak decision
exclusions: open/current local day from finalized series
records.freshness: Finalized after local day close; current day may be provisional and labeled
records.notes: The current day is returned as provisional; closed-day historical reporting is not yet exposed.

records.name: Current streak
records.formula: Number of consecutive closed local dates ending at yesterday whose streak_days adjudication_state is earned or frozen
records.grain: User as of a closed local business date
records.timezone: Each ledger row stores the immutable IANA timezone and local_date used for adjudication
exclusions: rows without qualifying evidence or valid freeze ledger link
records.freshness: After local day close or approved repair
records.notes: Closed-day Daily Review adjudication is implemented. Freeze allocation/consumption and historical repair remain pending owner policy.

records.name: Refreshes used
records.formula: COUNT(successful plan_refreshes for user and local_date)
exclusions: failed, rejected or replayed replacement requests
records.notes: Accepted selected-variant replacements are implemented. Provider-backed replacements and refresh-limit policy remain pending.

records.name: Weekly check-in completion
records.formula: COUNT(completed check-ins) / COUNT(check-ins due under the approved schedule policy)
records.timezone: Due decision uses approved user timezone policy; ISO year/week stored

records.name: AI cost per ready plan
records.grain: Ready plan over reporting period, currency and cost-version

records.name: Core synchronous API availability
records.formula: Good authenticated synthetic and real core API requests / eligible core API requests
records.grain: Eligible request classified by operation_id and environment
exclusions: planned synthetic exclusions documented before window

records.name: Daily Review persistence
records.formula: COUNT(acknowledged review mutations durably readable with matching idempotent result) / COUNT(acknowledged review mutations)
records.timezone: UTC acknowledgement; plan local_date retained as dimension
